authority: Approved Survival Paradise arm visual-reference sheets + user-provided failed runtime screenshots
notes: Shoulders must originate near the visible outer deltoid, not chest center.
Hands must read as hands at gameplay scale and remain proportionate to forearms.
Weapons must retain distinct stock/receiver/handguard/barrel or slide/grip mass.
This numeric contract is a regression floor; final acceptance still requires human visual comparison against the approved reference sheets.
Visual-fix-v2 second gate: shoulder sockets must sit higher/outboard at the deltoid; runtime weapon draw height must remain reference-like rather than blocky.
Hand bounds were recalibrated after the first v2 runtime pass: generated grip art now occupies most of its canvas, so previous 8–9 unit draw boxes produced oversized open hands.
Visual-fix-v2 shoulder bridge: full armed upper arms remain behind torso; only a short textured proximal cap is redrawn to make the deltoid attachment visible.

V2 grip calibration: rifle stock is visible at the shoulder, weapon art sockets and IK wrist targets share the same geometry, and visible hand occupancy is enlarged to match the approved grip reference.
